description: Defines data structures, classes, and functions for collecting, managing, and formatting transmission metrics related to RLC (Radio Link Control) in a wireless communication system. Includes mode-specific metrics for TM, UM, and AM modes, as well as formatting functions for reporting metrics.

classes.name: rlc_tx_metrics_higher
classes.description: Tracks high-level transmission metrics such as number of SDUs, dropped SDUs, and discard failures.

classes.name: rlc_tm_tx_metrics_lower
classes.description: Tracks lower-layer metrics specific to Transparent Mode (TM).

classes.name: rlc_um_tx_metrics_lower
classes.description: Tracks lower-layer metrics specific to Unacknowledged Mode (UM).

classes.name: rlc_am_tx_metrics_poll_latency
classes.description: Tracks latency measurements related to ACK polling in Acknowledged Mode (AM).

classes.name: rlc_am_tx_metrics_lower
classes.description: Tracks lower-layer metrics specific to Acknowledged Mode (AM), including retransmissions and latency.

classes.name: rlc_tx_metrics_lower
classes.description: Aggregates mode-specific lower-layer metrics and includes histograms and mode-specific variants.

classes.name: rlc_tx_metrics
classes.description: Main structure combining high and low transmission metrics.

classes.name: rlc_tx_metrics_interface
classes.description: Interface class for accessing and resetting RLC transmission metrics.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns a copy of the current metrics and increments the internal counter.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets all metrics to initial state.
